speaker: cateye81
transcript: Rich, Lord, I am glad that relay found you. But listen close: treat that antigen like the last medicine on earth, because it may be. Every report I copied said early stage—confusion, fever, still recognizing people and places. Once the eyes cloud and speech goes, nobody I trust could promise anything. Look after yourself first, and keep the package off the air. Before I went underground, I saw infected pull a young couple down outside Savannah and start feeding. They moved together like a pack. I know what the doctors call this, but some nights it feels like Hell opened its gates and gave the abominations free reign.
summary: CatEye81 confirms only uncertain early-stage reports, warns Rich to conceal the antigen, and describes what she witnessed near Savannah.
defaultEmotion: relieved, grave, candid, frightened, and careful about uncertainty
